purpose: Execute the first private backend repository day in a controlled order.

daySequence.label: Preflight
daySequence.action: Confirm GitHub access, repo name, owners, no live secrets, and local folder location.

daySequence.label: Create private repo
daySequence.action: Create dhirajnyse/pursuitdesk-platform as private, with main protected later after first checks appear.

daySequence.label: Clone and branch
daySequence.action: Clone locally, create develop, and keep main clean until first PR evidence is ready.

daySequence.label: Copy starter files
daySequence.action: Move starter files from the file-content export into the private repo shell.

daySequence.label: Import taxonomy
daySequence.action: Create labels and milestones before issues are opened.

daySequence.label: Open first issue wave
daySequence.action: Import generated issue bodies in M0/M1 order, with P0 shell and guard work first.

daySequence.label: First proof run
daySequence.action: Run install, lint, typecheck, route envelope, auth tenant, redaction, audit, and release gate placeholders.

daySequence.label: Open first PR
daySequence.action: Push develop, open the first PR to main, attach proof output, release note, rollback note, and signoffs.

daySequence.label: Review and evidence
daySequence.action: Platform, backend, security, database, governance, and QA owners review their lanes.

daySequence.label: Protect main
daySequence.action: Capture workflow names from the first run before branch rules become strict.

commandBlocks.label: Preflight
commandBlocks.proof: Confirms GitHub CLI identity before creating anything.

commandBlocks.label: Create repo
commandBlocks.command: gh repo create dhirajnyse/pursuitdesk-platform --private --description "Production SaaS backend for PursuitDesk" --confirm

commandBlocks.label: Clone
commandBlocks.proof: Pulls the clean private repo locally.

commandBlocks.label: Taxonomy
commandBlocks.command: gh label create ... / gh api repos/:owner/:repo/milestones
commandBlocks.proof: Applies the label and milestone catalog.

commandBlocks.label: Issue import
commandBlocks.proof: Opens generated issue bodies in the planned order.

commandBlocks.label: Install proof
commandBlocks.proof: Creates the first dependency proof or a clear placeholder note.

commandBlocks.label: First PR
commandBlocks.command: gh pr create --base main --head develop --draft --title "Initialize PursuitDesk backend shell"
commandBlocks.proof: Keeps the first merge reviewable and evidence-led.

issueWaves.label: Wave 1
issueWaves.name: Repo shell
issueWaves.scope: Open root shell, README, CODEOWNERS, PR template, env example, and release runbook issues first.

issueWaves.label: Wave 2
issueWaves.name: API boot
issueWaves.scope: Open server, app, route registry, safe error, request id, tenant scope, and access decision issues.

issueWaves.label: Wave 3
issueWaves.name: Data foundation
issueWaves.scope: Open schema, migration, seed, fixture, import dry-run, and restore gate issues.

issueWaves.label: Wave 4
issueWaves.name: Security proof
issueWaves.scope: Open tenant isolation, section access, commercial redaction, denial audit, and secrets checks.

issueWaves.label: Wave 5
issueWaves.name: CI and release
issueWaves.scope: Open workflow files, artifact retention, release gate, branch protection, and rollback issues.

issueWaves.label: Wave 6
issueWaves.name: Later alpha
issueWaves.scope: Hold billing, feedback, reports, customer success, and production hosting depth until shell proof is merged.

evidencePackets.contents: Repo URL, visibility, owners, created branch, and local path.
Labels, milestones, board columns, and issue routing rules applied.
Issue wave order, issue URLs, labels, milestones, and owner mapping.
Files copied from the export and any intentional deviation.
Install, lint, typecheck, test placeholders, and release gate outputs.
Linked issue, PR URL, reviewers, proof status, release note, and rollback note.
Exact GitHub Actions check names after the first run completes.
Required checks, reviews, environments, and bypass decisions after workflow names are known.

ownerCheckpoints.scope: Approves repo identity, alpha scope, issue priority, and no-go rules.
Owns repo creation, file copy, workflow names, branch rules, and PR evidence.
Owns API boot shell, route registry, package boundaries, and first proof commands.
Owns no-secret check, tenant/access guard, safe errors, redaction, and denial audit.
Owns schema placeholders, seed fixture location, migration order, and no-live-data rule.
Owns evidence packet, release-gate summary, branch protection timing, and go/no-go note.

liveGates.label: Before repo create
liveGates.gate: Repo name, privacy, owner, local folder, GitHub login, and no live data confirmed.

liveGates.label: Before taxonomy import
liveGates.gate: Label catalog, milestone catalog, owner lanes, and proof labels checked.

liveGates.label: Before issue import
liveGates.gate: M0/M1 opening order and issue body templates reviewed.

liveGates.label: Before first PR
liveGates.gate: Starter file inventory, no-secret scan, proof placeholders, and release note prepared.

liveGates.label: Before branch protection
liveGates.gate: First workflow run has produced exact status check names.

liveGates.label: Before merge
liveGates.gate: Role signoffs, proof outputs, linked issue, rollback note, and no-go scan complete.

liveGates.label: Before staging work
liveGates.gate: Shell PR merged cleanly and release-gate summary has no hard blockers.

liveGates.label: Before live data
liveGates.gate: Tenant, access, redaction, audit, import rollback, backups, and billing test mode are real.

noGoStops.label: Live secret appears
noGoStops.response: Stop, rotate the secret, purge history, and restart with a clean branch.

noGoStops.label: Repo is public
noGoStops.response: Stop before uploading starter files; recreate or change visibility to private.

noGoStops.label: Main receives direct commit
noGoStops.response: Stop and restore PR discipline before any protection rule is applied.

noGoStops.label: Workflow checks unknown
noGoStops.response: Hold branch protection until exact GitHub check names are visible.

noGoStops.label: Commercial data leaks
noGoStops.response: Stop, remove value, agreement, billing, and negotiation data from operational examples.

noGoStops.label: Issue trace missing
noGoStops.response: Hold the PR until it links to generated issue, labels, milestone, and proof lane.

acceptanceChecks.label: Sequence is executable
acceptanceChecks.check: Ten timed steps cover preflight through branch protection.

acceptanceChecks.label: Commands are named
acceptanceChecks.check: Ten command blocks define the opening-day path.

acceptanceChecks.label: Issues are sequenced
acceptanceChecks.check: Six import waves keep foundation and security work first.

acceptanceChecks.label: Evidence is named
acceptanceChecks.check: Eight proof packets tell the team what to save.

acceptanceChecks.label: Owners are assigned
acceptanceChecks.check: Six owner lanes show who signs off.

acceptanceChecks.label: Gates are clear
acceptanceChecks.check: Eight decision gates prevent premature merge, protection, staging, or live data.

acceptanceChecks.label: Stops are explicit
acceptanceChecks.check: Six no-go stops tell the team when to pause.

acceptanceChecks.label: Next handoff ready
acceptanceChecks.check: v125 can turn this into an executive decision memo for creating the real repo.

handoff: v124 converts the backend preparation stack into a day-one private repo operating rhythm.
The runbook keeps repo creation, taxonomy import, starter files, first issues, proof commands, first PR, owner signoffs, and branch protection in the correct order.
Branch protection remains deliberately late: the team first lets GitHub Actions reveal exact required status check names, then protects main.
v125 can produce the executive decision memo for opening the real private backend repo with known scope, evidence, blockers, and approval gates.
